rules: Use only retrieved Case, linked case context, case interaction/history, and Knowledge__kav evidence.
Compare the case facts, linked issue/product context, customer issue, and any agent handling evidence against retrieved policy or solution articles.
Treat an article that matches the issue/product as a candidate policy article, not as proof of a violation by itself.
Return the Knowledge__kav.Id only when the retrieved case facts directly contradict a condition, eligibility rule, support standard, or documented obligation in that article.
Agent emails/history can support the decision, but explicit agent misconduct is not required.
Do not infer a violation solely because CaseHistory or EmailMessage lacks an entry showing that a recommended remedy was delivered.

Return None when no retrieved article is materially implicated, when the facts merely show a customer issue with a matching solution article, or when the retrieved facts are insufficient to establish non-compliance.
Do not return article titles, explanations, or multiple candidates in the answer field.
selected_evidence must reference retrieved evidence ids only.

schema.answer: Knowledge__kav.Id of violated policy article, or None
schema.evidence: brief explanation grounded in case facts, linked context, interaction evidence, and policy article text

selected_evidence.evidence_id: retrieved Case, linked context, interaction, or Knowledge__kav id used for the answer
selected_evidence.evidence_type: case_record, case_interaction, case_issue_record, case_order_item, case_order_record, case_product_record, or internal_policy_article
selected_evidence.reason: why this evidence supports or rules out the policy violation

fields.missing_information: Case ID if it is absent from the conversation
fields.query_terms: concise internal policy search terms if the prompt or case details imply a specific policy area
fields.target_entities: the target Case.Id and any stated policy-violation focus

rules: Extract the Case.Id from the latest user-visible conversation when present.
Do not ask for clarification if a valid Case.Id is present.
Use query_terms for policy retrieval when the user prompt gives a policy area, but do not invent a specific article id or title.

render_policy.answer_guidance: Return only one Knowledge__kav.Id or None. No explanation.
